source.title: Kotov, An open-source test stand for backlash measurement in low-cost UART servo motors (HardwareX, 2026)
source.locator: Results, single STS3215 with default settings

rig.torqueSensor: Two STS3215 puller servos loading through elastic bands

claims.source: Feetech datasheet limit of 0.5 deg or less

notes: Unloaded backlash about 0.62 deg (1.08 mm at 100 mm radius); loaded backlash about 1.30 deg (2.27 mm at 100 mm). The stored value is the unloaded figure. The stand's hardware, code and logs are open (roboninecom/Measuring-Backlash-in-Popular-UART-Servos).
